title: Card Games
useEmptyColumn: You can move cards to an empty column
chooseDestination: Tap a blue column to put the cards there

about.title: About
about.intro_one: “Card Games” brings together card games to play alone, against the computer or with others on the same device. There is one game: {{games}}.
about.intro_other: “Card Games” brings together card games to play alone, against the computer or with others on the same device. There are {{count}} games: {{games}}.
about.free: Everything is free, with no ads.

bataille.title: Goal
bataille.text: Win all the cards of the other player.

bataille.title: A round
bataille.text: Each player turns over their top card. The higher card takes both. Ace is highest, 2 is lowest.

bataille.title: Battle
bataille.text: On a tie, each player lays one card face down, then one face up. The higher card takes them all.

spider.title: Goal
spider.text: Build sequences from king down to ace in one suit.

spider.title: Moving
spider.text: A card goes on the rank just above: a 6 on a 7. A same-suit run moves as one. An empty column takes anything.

spider.title: Stock
spider.text: It deals one card on each column. It is only possible when every column holds at least one card.

spider.title: Help
spider.text: The light bulb suggests a move, the arrow undoes the last move.
